dashboard.label: TA-patch Overview
dashboard.description: Collects patch compliance: upgradable package count (security vs total where distinguishable), days since the last successful apt/dnf transaction (from package-manager history

search.query: | mstats avg("patch.upgradable") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("patch.security_upgradable") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1

index=main sourcetype="patch:status" | where isnotnull(upgradable) AND upgradable!="" | sort 0 - _time | dedup host | spath input=_raw output=n path=upgradable | where isnotnull(n) AND n!="" | eval n=tonumber(n) | stats sum(n) as value

index=main sourcetype="patch:status" | where isnotnull(upgradable) AND upgradable!="" | sort 0 - _time | dedup host | table host _time pm release upgradable security_upgradable not_upgraded days_since_update | eval upg_num=tonumber(upgradable) | sort - upg_num | fields - upg_num
